_comment: Revvel Custom MCP Servers — all MIDNGHTSAPPHIRE custom repos. Merge into your project's .mcp.json alongside mcp.web.json or mcp.minimal.json. Requires local clones of MCT modules built with npm run build. See docs/MCP_REVVEL_CATALOG.md for setup instructions.

rvvel-affiliate-links._comment: Mandatory in every project. No env vars needed — self-contained SQLite.

code-review._comment: Mandatory in every project. Set CODE_REVIEW_MCP_PATH to your local clone of code-review-mcp-server.

mct-analytics._comment: Add when project needs analytics tracking. MCP tool: get_analytics_data.

mct-subscription._comment: Add when project has subscriptions. MCP tool: getSubscriptions.

mct-admin-dashboard._comment: Add when project has admin user management. MCP tools: getUsers, addUser.

mct-customer-support._comment: Add when project needs AI-assisted customer support. MCP tool: fetchCustomerData.

mct-user-dashboard._comment: Add when project manages user profiles. MCP tools: getUserData, updateUserData.

mct-website-generator._comment: Add when project generates websites. MCP tool: generateWebsite.

mct-content-calendar._comment: Add when project needs content scheduling. MCP SDK connected, tools pending.

mct-auth._comment: REST API microservice. MCP tools pending. Add when project needs auth management.

mct-payment._comment: REST API microservice. MCP tools pending. Add when project tracks payments.

mct-affiliate._comment: REST API for affiliate partner management. Different from rvvel-affiliate-links. Tools pending.

mct-email-marketing._comment: REST API for email campaign management. MCP tools pending.

mct-ad-campaign._comment: Ad campaign management. Partial tools: getCampaigns, createCampaign.

mct-seo-accessibility._comment: SEO and accessibility scanning. Partial tools: seo, accessibility.

mct-branding._comment: Brand management REST API. MCP tools pending.

mct-ab-testing._comment: A/B test tracking. MCP tools pending. Uses SQLite.

mct-data-management._comment: Project data CRUD. MCP tools pending. Uses SQLite.

mct-code-review-records._comment: Code review data store (NOT the scanner). Stores review records in MongoDB.
